column2: A small car driving past on a quiet road, soft engine hum passing by from left to right
A wheeled suitcase rolling over a hotel lobby floor, short
An old mobile phone ringing twice, a classic ringtone, slightly muffled in a hotel room
A clock ticking very fast like a time-lapse, hours passing quickly, mechanical ticks speeding up
A soft fetal heartbeat on a doppler, steady at first then slowing down, muffled
A sheet of thick paper being torn in half slowly, crisp and dramatic
An old metal balance scale tipping to one side with a soft creak and a light clink
A quiet hotel room at night: very soft air conditioning hum and distant faint traffic, almost silent
Early morning outside a city hotel: soft birdsong and distant light traffic, calm
Heavy iron prison bars slamming shut with a loud metallic clang and short echo
